# Aetherion - Complete Routing & Pages Report

## Architecture Overview

The application uses **React Router v6** with **lazy loading** for all route components. Routes are defined in a centralized config (`src/app/routes/routeConfig.ts`) and rendered by `AppRoutes.tsx`. The root `src/app.tsx` wraps everything in `<BrowserRouter>`, Redux `<Provider>`, and `redux-persist` `<PersistGate>`.

### Route Config File
**`src/app/routes/routeConfig.ts`** — Defines ~110+ routes as a `RouteItem[]` array with:
- `path`: URL path
- `component`: Lazy-loaded component
- `isProtected`: Boolean — requires authentication
- `roles[]`: Allowed user roles (e.g. `['patient']`, `['doctor', 'admin']`)
- `title`: Page title

### Route Rendering (`src/app/routes/AppRoutes.tsx`)
- **`AuthGuard`**: Checks Redux auth state + sessionStorage token. Redirects to `/login` if unauthenticated, or to `/` if wrong role.
- **`PublicGuard`**: If already logged in, redirects from `/login` or `/register` to `/${userRole}/dashboard`.
- Handles special case `hospital/:id` with a wrapper component.
- The catch-all `*` route maps to the 404 NotFound page.

### Role-Based Dashboard Mapping (`src/context/AuthContext.tsx`)
```
patient/client → /patient/dashboard
doctor         → /doctor/dashboard
hospital       → /hospital/dashboard
pharmacy       → /pharmacy/dashboard
admin/super_admin → /admin/dashboard

### AI Assistant Sub-Routing (`src/config/routes.config.tsx`)
A secondary routing config for the AI Dashboard panel at `/ai-assistant`. Defines sidebar routes (chat, analytics, predictions, automation, agents, knowledge, training, settings) and feature routes (baby-care, pregnancy, symptoms, recommendations), each mapped to a lazy-loaded component.

# Aetherion - Complete Routing & Pages Report

## Architecture Overview

The application uses **React Router v6** with **lazy loading** for all route components. Routes are defined in a centralized config (`src/app/routes/routeConfig.ts`) and rendered by `AppRoutes.tsx`. The root `src/app.tsx` wraps everything in `<BrowserRouter>`, Redux `<Provider>`, and `redux-persist` `<PersistGate>`.

### Route Config File
**`src/app/routes/routeConfig.ts`** — Defines ~110+ routes as a `RouteItem[]` array with:
- `path`: URL path
- `component`: Lazy-loaded component
- `isProtected`: Boolean — requires authentication
- `roles[]`: Allowed user roles (e.g. `['patient']`, `['doctor', 'admin']`)
- `title`: Page title

### Route Rendering (`src/app/routes/AppRoutes.tsx`)
- **`AuthGuard`**: Checks Redux auth state + sessionStorage token. Redirects to `/login` if unauthenticated, or to `/` if wrong role.
- **`PublicGuard`**: If already logged in, redirects from `/login` or `/register` to `/${userRole}/dashboard`.
- Handles special case `hospital/:id` with a wrapper component.
- The catch-all `*` route maps to the 404 NotFound page.

### Role-Based Dashboard Mapping (`src/context/AuthContext.tsx`)
```
patient/client → /patient/dashboard
doctor         → /doctor/dashboard
hospital       → /hospital/dashboard
pharmacy       → /pharmacy/dashboard
admin/super_admin → /admin/dashboard

A secondary routing config for the AI Dashboard panel at `/ai-assistant`. Defines sidebar routes (chat, analytics, predictions, automation, agents, knowledge, training, settings) and feature routes (baby-care, pregnancy, symptoms, recommendations), each mapped to a lazy-loaded component.
